title: Knife & Fire Foundations
description: Where every cook begins: heat control, seasoning, and the pan. These five dishes teach more technique per minute than any others in the guide.

title: Stocks, Soups & the Simmer
description: Liquid is the kitchen's bank account. Learn dashi's restraint, the onion's patience, and why the bubble matters more than the clock.

title: The Sauté Station & Pan Sauces
description: The line cook's exam: sear, deglaze, mount, plate — four moves that turn a pan's residue into a restaurant's sauce.

title: The Braise
description: Collagen's slow surrender. Tough cuts, low heat, and time — the semester where patience becomes flavor.

title: Bread & Fermentation
description: Flour, water, salt, time. Gluten's architecture and the wild yeast's schedule — the most humbling and rewarding station.

title: Pastry Fundamentals
description: Precision's kingdom: custards that set at a degree, sugar that becomes glass, dough that becomes a thousand layers.

title: Fire & Smoke
description: Live fire is an ingredient. Two-zone discipline, the collagen clock at 110°C, and thin blue smoke as doctrine.

title: The Wok & High Heat
description: Breath of the wok: maximum heat, total mise, small batches. The fastest cooking in the guide and the least forgiving.

title: Seafood Mastery
description: The two-clock family, the freshness verdict, and the courage to serve fish barely touched.

title: The Restaurateur's Capstone
description: The final semester cooks for a room, not a plate: mother sauces at scale, the holiday bird, theater desserts — and the numbers behind them.
